title: Oratio ad immortalitatem illustriassimae nec non famigerratissimae laudis
shelf_note: A 1562 humanist civic oration in praise of Lodi (Laus Pompeia): its Roman foundation by Gn. Pompeius, its sackings by the Milanese, its jurists (Oldradus). It is a genuine Latin manuscript, but no tradition or collection is given, and the topic is local history, not alchemy, Hermetica or early science.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. The scribe's page numbers (4, 15, 26) match image indices 14, 25 and 36 at a constant offset of 10, so the run is consistent. The translation is null on all three pages: transcription only.

book_verdict: The transcription of this clear italic humanist hand is generally good. All three pages are the right leaves and none has an invented passage. Page 14 has two non-word misreadings ('quasit' for 'euasit', 'aboliorem' for 'atrociorem'), and two proper names are slightly wrong (Coloneum, Tressonus). No translation is stored yet.
